title: Just sort it! A note on the LP behind rank-one anti-loop edits

headline_result.text: Replacing the LP that builds the rank-one anti-loop edit with a sort of 8 low-variation neurons gives 67.0% vs 67.4% for the LP edit and 9.5% for the unedited Qwen3.5-0.8B on 1000 problems.
headline_result.quote: On Qwen3.5-0.8B the sorted edit scores 67.0% on 1000 problems (MATH- 500 and GSM8K) against 67.4% for the LP edit and 9.5% for the unedited model

key_claims.claim: The LP solution does not separate looping and productive tokens; it pushes both by similar amounts, i.e. it synthesizes a bias along u.
key_claims.quote: Hence the LP synthesizes a bias along u, by using neurons that are almost always active.

key_claims.claim: The sorted edit is within a pre-declared 5-point non-inferiority margin of the LP edit.
key_claims.quote: the paired difference is −0.4 points, with 95% confidence interval [−2.9, +2.1], inside a non-inferiority margin of 5 points declared before the runs.

key_claims.claim: Over three further sampling seeds, the sort and a dose set without the LP both stay within the margin.
key_claims.quote: On three further sampling seeds the difference is −0.6 points, interval [−2.0, +0.8], and −0.8 points, interval [−2.3, +0.6], when the dose is set without the LP.

key_claims.claim: The neurons shared by the sort and LP supports carry most of the LP's mean push.
key_claims.quote: the neurons shared by the two supports carry 95% (layer 15) and 88% (layer 19) of the mean

key_claims.claim: The author concludes the informative part of the edit is the direction u, not the LP.
key_claims.quote: In our view the informative part of the AHA edit is the direction u, not the LP that implements it.

limitations_stated.text: Only one model and one run of the pipeline producing u were tested.
limitations_stated.quote: Admittedly, we tested one model and one run of the pipeline that produces u.

limitations_stated.text: A constant shift along u at the same dose (steering arm) was not tested.
limitations_stated.quote: We did not test a constant shift along u at the same dose.

limitations_stated.text: Seeds measure sampling noise on fixed edits, not replication of the pipeline.
limitations_stated.quote: the seeds measure the sampling noise on fixed edits; they do not replicate the pipeline that

notes_for_review: A short note that tests the LP component of the AHA (non-LLM) rank-one anti-loop edit on Qwen3.5-0.8B and finds a simple neuron sort matches it within a pre-registered margin. No LLM edits weights here; the work is a mechanical-baseline critique of the LP step, with pre-registered protocols and released code/data. The paper states the work was done largely by Claude (Fable 5.2, Opus 5.5) in one day. Uses one sample per problem, 500 MATH + 500 GSM8K problems, four sampling seeds in total.
